authentication_assumption: The existing server has no global authentication middleware; Workbench follows the current internal-application API assumption.

responses.200: Existing terminal execution is reused without starting work; a prior latest successful attempt is preferred for a normal resubmission.
responses.202: A new attempt is RUNNING, or the matching PENDING/RUNNING attempt is returned.
responses.415: Request body media type or JSON encoding is unsupported.
responses.429: Execution capacity or the 100-attempt per-run bound prevents a new execution. One capacity BLOCKED attempt is reused for repeated requests against the same active lease.
responses.500: Safe unexpected-error envelope; no client stack trace.

idempotency.matching_pending_or_running: Return the existing attempt; do not start another process.
idempotency.matching_success: Return the latest successful attempt by default.
idempotency.failed_or_blocked_without_success: Return the latest immutable terminal attempt; do not silently retry.

routes.returns: Bounded run summaries with latest status and successful-attempt reference.

returns: latest terminal result or explicit availability sentinel
latest successful result when one exists

request.meaning: Reuse the immutable stored normalized specification.

responses.202: A new execution_attempt_id is created under the same run_id and execution starts.
responses.400: Request contains fields or run_id is malformed.
responses.429: Execution capacity or the 100-attempt per-run bound prevents a new execution; repeated requests against the same active lease reuse its immutable BLOCKED attempt.

routes.requires: A successful immutable attempt for both run IDs.

run_identity.input: Canonical normalized supported ResearchRunSpec including data, certified-engine and adapter identities.

canonicalization.dates: Canonical YYYY-MM-DD values fixed by the normalized spec
canonicalization.numbers: Finite JSON shortest representation; negative zero becomes zero
canonicalization.arrays: Order preserved and sparse arrays rejected
canonicalization.defaults: All supported fixed values expanded before hashing

execution_attempt_identity.semantics: One immutable physical attempt; reruns keep run_id and receive a distinct attempt ID.

result_semantics.financial_result_hash: Scenario-specific hash of actual financial outputs and identities; excludes runtime telemetry and attempt metadata.
result_semantics.unavailable_output: NOT_SUPPORTED or a precise BLOCKED value; in-progress latest results use NOT_AVAILABLE_WHILE_PENDING_OR_RUNNING.
result_semantics.success_meaning: Execution mechanics completed; it is not promotion, authorization, allocation, a recommendation, or an economic claim.
